title: Fix blank white screen rendering issue

requirements.text: Diagnose and fix the blank white screen issue preventing the application from rendering. Check for JavaScript errors in browser console, React component mounting failures, routing configuration issues in App.tsx, and ThemeProvider initialization problems.
acceptanceCriteria: Application loads without displaying a blank white screen
Landing page renders correctly at root route
Dashboard pages render correctly when authenticated
No JavaScript errors appear in browser console
Router successfully initializes and handles navigation

requirements.text: Verify that frontend/src/main.tsx properly initializes the React application with RouterProvider, QueryClientProvider, and InternetIdentityProvider in the correct order without throwing errors.
acceptanceCriteria: React root successfully mounts to the #root element
All providers wrap the router without configuration errors
Internet Identity context initializes without blocking render

requirements.text: Ensure App.tsx router configuration properly defines all routes including root landing page (/), dashboard routes, admin routes, and legal pages without circular dependencies or missing imports.
acceptanceCriteria: Root route (/) successfully renders LandingPage component
All route components are properly imported
Router creates without throwing configuration errors
Lazy-loaded routes properly resolve their component imports

requirements.text: Verify that CSS is loading correctly by checking that frontend/index.html references the correct stylesheet, Tailwind CSS processes properly, and no critical CSS syntax errors prevent styles from applying.
acceptanceCriteria: Tailwind CSS utility classes apply correctly to components
Custom CSS variables defined in index.css are available
Theme colors render properly in both light and dark modes
No CSS parsing errors in browser developer tools

constraints: Do not modify frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts or other immutable hook files
Do not change the single-actor backend architecture
Preserve all existing route definitions and component structure
nonGoals: Modifying backend logic or data models
